c: The Milky Way Map is a relic located in
. Once collected, it permanently unlocks a viewable map in the pause menu. The map displays the player's location as well as the locations of pickups, stage items, relics,
coffins, and
Treasure Chests in any stage.
A "Show Guides"/"Hide Guides" button is also added to the pause menu, which, when toggled on, displays an arrow pointing to each item with that item's icon.

cells: Unlocks the map in the pause menu.

c: The Milky Way Map is located to the far south of the starting area in Dairy Plant. Its location is tracked by a green arrow on the player's screen. Once the Milky Way Map has been collected, it will no longer appear on the map.
Alternatively, the Milky Way Map can be unlocked in the
by casting the spell "leadmetothecheese".
